channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Reforms target serious flaws in service justice system
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has set out a programme of reforms aimed at strengthening and modernising the Service Justice System, including changes under the Armed Forces Bill focused on victim support and improved handling of serious offences. The post Reforms target serious flaws in service justice system first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO warfare hub maps five-year plan for future exercises
item.description: The NATO Joint Warfare Centre (JWC) has launched a new five-year campaign plan intended to guide its work on training, exercises and warfare development through to 2030. The post NATO warfare hub maps five-year plan for future exercises first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy Peregrine drone saved from crashing
item.description: A Royal Navy drone operator has been recognised after rapid intervention prevented an unmanned helicopter from plunging into the sea during operations aboard HMS Lancaster. The post Royal Navy Peregrine drone saved from crashing first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: RAF mission boosts UK Antarctic cooperation with Chile
item.description: British Forces South Atlantic Islands personnel based at Mount Pleasant have conducted Operation AUSTRAL ENDURANCE, working alongside Chilean counterparts and UK partners to strengthen safe access to the British Antarctic Territory. The post RAF mission boosts UK Antarctic cooperation with Chile first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Russian hacktivists targeting UK online services
item.description: The National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) has issued a new alert warning that Russian state-aligned hacktivist groups continue to target UK organisations with disruptive cyber attacks. The post Russian hacktivists targeting UK online services first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Virtual Flag coalition drill tests multi-domain warfare
item.description: The U.S. Air Force integrated U.S. personnel alongside international partners including the Royal Air Force, UK Space Command, Royal Australian Air Force, Australian Army, Royal Canadian Air Force and Royal Canadian Navy. The post Virtual Flag coalition drill tests multi-domain warfare first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. to give Marine Cobra helis long-range strike weapons
item.description: According to L3Harris, the Red Wolf system is intended to address what it described as a capability gap by providing long-range precision strike options suited to modern conflict environments. The post U.S. to give Marine Cobra helis long-range strike weapons first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. Navy awards Link 16 radio contract to Data Link
item.description: Data Link Solutions is a joint venture between BAE Systems and Collins Aerospace, an RTX business. The post U.S. Navy awards Link 16 radio contract to Data Link first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Leonardo climbs UK Glassdoor best workplace rankings
item.description: Leonardo has been named as one of the Best Places to Work in the Glassdoor Employees Choice Awards 2026 for the second year running, the company stated. The post Leonardo climbs UK Glassdoor best workplace rankings first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Shipbuilding must not repeat past industrial failures
item.description: The Scottish Affairs Committee has warned that Scotland risks repeating the mistakes of past deindustrialisation unless future industrial transitions are actively managed, with clear support for skills retention. The post Shipbuilding must not repeat past industrial failures first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
